title: Devotees yiñ woote
intro: Benn yonent buñu jox cër dafa doxantu ci biir nit ñi, di leen woo ñu ñëw ci dëgg gi. Ñu bari dellu ginaaw ndax dëgër bopp, waaye ñu bari ñu gëm seen boroom nangu nañu woote bi, ñu nangu seen bopp ak seen xol yépp. Ñu natt leen ak sikki-sakka, ñu ñeme wut dundu asamaan si. Seen ngor gu mat sëkk moo nekkoon njàngale budul jeex ci ngëm. Ñan lañu woon ?
clues: Nun mbooloo mu ndaw lanu woon, nu jog ngir jàppale misioŋu boroomam ci jamonoy gëm-gëmu bu tasaaroo.
Benn yonent buñu jox cër dafa ñëw woo nu nu taxaw ci yoonu Yàlla.
Bi yonent bi laajee kan mooy jàppale Yàlla, nu tontu ci lu amul benn xalaat.
Nu ñeme ñaan màggalug kéemtaan bu wàcci ci asamaan si ngir dëgëral sunuy xol.
Sunu yonent daf nu fàttali ni danu wara sargal Yàlla sudee gëm nañu dëgg, waaye sunu ñaan bu woyof bi nangu nañu ko.
Nun la woon ci sunu biir, ñu ànd ak Isa, doomu Maryam, di ngëm gu dëgër.

identity.label: Man Kan laa?
options: hawariyyun yi (taalibé isa)
Ashab al-Kahf (nit ñi ci grotte)
Waa Madyan
Waa Samud
Sahaba yu Talut (Saul)

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: di leen sàkku ñu nekk ay jappalekat ci yoonu Yàlla
Seede ab njiit di waxtaan ak ab yonent
Ñu digal ko mu baale benn gaam bu jigéen bu def kéemtaanu
Daw dugg ci lëmu doj ngir mucc ci fitna
Jàll dex ngir natt déggal
trial.answer: di leen sàkku ñu nekk ay jappalekat ci yoonu Yàlla

location.label: Ëlëm bu am solo
options: Taabal bu tasaaroo asamaan si (Mawlidah)
Ark bu mag bi ci kaw ndoxu mbënd mi
Gaam bu jigéen bu génn ci xeer
Baton bu soppiku nekk jaan
Palais bu yéeg ba ci asamaan si

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Nu nekk gëmkat yu dëgër te am ndam
Nu yàq ci mbugal mu jóge ci kaw
Mbënd mu metti moo nu mbëgg
Nu nelawoon ci lëmu doj ay téemeeri at
Dañu nu tere dugg ci réew mu sell mi
outcome.answer: Nu nekk gëmkat yu dëgër te am ndam

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
